title: LoopZeroKit services.json (v1 + v2)
description: Platform-neutral services manifest emitted by `loopzerokit build`. Mirror of loopzerokit/packages/loopruntime/src/services/adapters-bridge/manifest.ts ServicesManifest interface. Plan B v3.1 T-B.3 + ADR-0015 (platform-neutral). Plan v1.2 T2.1: v2 carries top-level `project` field (DNS-1123); v1 retained for backward compat with deprecation warning, falls back to `services-bundle` per ADR D10 (preserves Gitea repo lineage).

project.description: DNS-1123 subdomain compatible project name. Required from v2. Drives Gitea repo (loopruntime-source-{tenant}-{project}) and ArgoCD App naming.

runtime.description: Runtime that owns the service process. Resolved to the build's LanguageStrategy by buildplane/argo ResolveStrategy.

type.description: Service shape. server | worker. Defaults to `server` when omitted (Go-side fallback — JSON Schema 7 doesn't apply default automatically). `frontend` removed in plan simplify-deploy-loopzerokit-only v2.0 (D5) — LoopZeroKit serves no static frontends.

port.description: TCP port the service binds to inside its container. Range 1024-65535 — ports below 1024 are reserved (require CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE which the runtime does NOT grant, and ARE collision-prone with kubelet / kube-proxy on host networking).

proxy.description: Non-empty path segment after `/`; cannot be `/` (would catch-all and conflict with LoopZeroKit routing).

env.description: Process environment variables passed to the running service. Keys MUST be POSIX-compliant (^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$); values are bounded to 4096 chars. Total entries capped at 64 to prevent manifest-bomb DoS. Plan v1.2 T1.3 — additional Go-side blocklist rejects reserved keys (PATH, HOME, LD_PRELOAD, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, KUBERNETES_*, LOOPRUNTIME_*).
